content:
I said few times we are been lied to about  Tokamaks since their invention in 1960s by Russia and Lev Artsimovich. They knew commercial tokamaks are possible even back then don't believe me look at his  words from 1960s he died in 1971. #ufotwitter 

This is what he said when he was asked when the first functional tokamak power plant would be built. His words were: “When humanity needs it, or a little earlier.”

His words give you the impression that they knew much more than they publicly told us; that's how the veil of secrecy works in both the United States and Russia.

There is also possibility of using Tokamaks for fusion propulsion, Tokamak acts primarily as a power generator, not a direct thruster. 

However, ideas exist to adapt it, such as a reverse field configuration (RFC) variant (likely referring to field-reversed configuration or similar open/hybrid designs) where plasma might escape the torus as a high-energy jet.

If you followed recent news US, China, Germany, Russia, South Korea, UK, France and Japan will put first operational commercial tokamaks or stellarators by 2034.
